criteria.label: Problem Validation
criteria.description: Evidence that target users have this problem and will pay to solve it
riskIndicators: Building based on assumption, not research
fixSuggestions: Interview 20 potential users about the problem
Find 5 people willing to pay before building
Create landing page to test demand
Study why existing solutions fail

criteria.label: Market Size & Timing
criteria.description: Large enough market with good timing
riskIndicators: Niche too small to build venture-scale business
fixSuggestions: Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM realistically
Find adjacent markets for expansion
Target emerging category with tailwinds
Focus on underserved segment of large market

criteria.label: Execution Ability
criteria.description: Team capability to build and iterate quickly
fixSuggestions: Find technical co-founder or learn to code
Use no-code tools for MVP
Focus on simpler product scope initially
Commit full-time or find someone who can

criteria.label: Distribution Strategy
riskIndicators: Build it and they will come mentality
Competing for attention in crowded space
fixSuggestions: Identify one distribution channel to own
Build virality or network effects into product
Create content that attracts target users
Partner with platforms that have your users

criteria.label: Business Model
criteria.description: Viable way to monetize that aligns with user value
riskIndicators: Users expect it to be free
Low willingness to pay in category
Need massive scale for ad model
fixSuggestions: Validate pricing with potential customers
Consider B2B if B2C won't pay
Build monetization into core product loop
Start with premium/paid before free

failurePatterns.description: Building technology without validated customer need
Great product but no way to reach customers
Building too many features before validating core value
